en.title: Rory's Masters Odds Climb
en.summary: Rory McIlroy's probability to win the 2026 Masters rose by 1.5% to 9.5%. This increase is likely driven by new "surprising PGA predictions" from a CBS Sports golf model with a strong track record for the 2026 Masters.
drivers: CBS Sports model's "surprising" 2026 Masters predictions
Market reaction to new analytical golf insights
en.why_matters: This shift indicates that expert models are beginning to see a stronger path for McIlroy at Augusta, potentially influencing future betting patterns and fan expectations for the major.
